# hivelocity_vps_snapshot_schedule (Resource)

Schedules automatic snapshots of a VPS volume. Schedules cannot be modified through the API, so any change replaces the schedule.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hivelocity_vps_snapshot_schedule" "nightly" {
  volume_id     = hivelocity_vps_volume.data.volume_id
  facility_code = hivelocity_vps_volume.data.facility_code
  interval_type = "DAILY"
  hour          = 2
  minute        = 30
  max_snapshots = 7
  timezone      = "America/New_York"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `facility_code` (String) Facility of the volume, for example `TPA1`.
- `hour` (Number) Hour of the day to run (0-23).
- `interval_type` (String) `DAILY`, `WEEKLY` or `MONTHLY`.
- `max_snapshots` (Number) Maximum number of snapshots to retain for this schedule.
- `minute` (Number) Minute of the hour to run (0-59).
- `timezone` (String) IANA timezone of the schedule, for example `America/New_York`.
- `volume_id` (String) ID of the volume to snapshot.

### Optional

- `day` (Number) Day of the month to run (1-28). Required for `MONTHLY`.
- `weekday` (Number) Day of the week to run (1-7, 1 being Monday). Required for `WEEKLY`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `snapshot_schedule_id` (String) Unique ID of the schedule.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import with the schedule ID
terraform import hivelocity_vps_snapshot_schedule.nightly sched-abc123
```
